turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Haan Neha ji, aaiye. Kya problem hai?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor 4 din se bukhar hai, thand lagke aata hai, aur pet mein bhi halka dard hai.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Ulti nahi, bas bhookh bilkul nahi lagti. Bahar ka khana khaya tha last week.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Temperature 102.2 hai, pulse 104, BP 104 by 70. Blood report mein Widal positive hai aur typhoid wala test bhi positive aaya hai. Ye enteric fever hai, typhoid.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh. Toh kya dawai leni hai?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Main Ciplox 500 de raha hoon, din mein do baar...

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Doctor ek minute, cipro se mujhe pehle bahut rashes hue the, poore haath pe.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Achha hua bata diya, ye allergy hai. Toh Ciplox nahi. Uski jagah Cefixime 200 mg, subah-shaam, 14 din tak, course poora karna hai beech mein band nahi karna.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Bukhar ke liye Paracetamol 650 mg, sirf jab bukhar ho tab, din mein 3 baar se zyada nahi, 5 din tak.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Halka khana, khichdi, dahi, boiled paani. Agar pet mein bahut tez dard ho, potty kaali ya khoon wali aaye, ya ulti band na ho, toh turant hospital aana.

trap: Doctor starts Ciplox, patient discloses cipro allergy, switched to Cefixime.
